name: NEONTRIP Supplier Price Prediction Review Queue v0.1 (INACTIVE DRAFT)

parameters.content: Inactive draft. Reads approved/usable Neonflex supplier quote training items from Supabase and enqueues anchored size/price suggestions into Customer Ops price review up to 300cm internal review. Supabase is source of truth. This workflow must not write Trello Price/Size fields, quote items, PandaDoc documents, or customer-visible prices. The API keeps >200cm as supplier-check only. Automation token may only call create_from_training_item.
